asciiPanel:
Create Library (CRTLIB)

Type choices, press Enter.

Library . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . > ________

  *CURLIB      Current library
  *LIBL        Library list

Bottom
F3=Exit   F4=Prompt   F5=Refresh   F9=Add program   F12=Cancel
F13=How to use this display   F24=More keys
functionKeys: F3=Exit   F4=Prompt   F5=Refresh   F9=Add program   F12=Cancel   F24=More keys
notes: Generic command prompt pattern: English description + (COMMAND) heading, parameter list with choice columns, no Selection line (differs from menus). F4 on command line or over a parameter opens prompt via QCAPCMD. F11 toggles keywords vs choices; F9 shows all parameters.
